# Ali Sadeghi Interactive Portfolio

> Ali Sadeghi's personal portfolio presents selected software projects, professional experience, measurable impact, technical tools, and a bilingual account of how the site was designed and built.

The canonical site is https://ali-sdg.is-a.dev/. It is a single-page React application with English and Persian content. Treat project dates, metrics, and descriptions as portfolio claims made by the site owner. The repository and original content use a custom all-rights-reserved license; this file grants no additional rights.

## Primary resources

- [Live portfolio](https://ali-sdg.is-a.dev/): The canonical interactive website.
- [English resume](https://ali-sdg.is-a.dev/resume/ali-sadeghi-resume-en.pdf): The current public resume in PDF format.
- [Project overview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Ali-Sdg90/ali-sdg90.github.io/main/README.md): Architecture, features, local setup, and development workflow.
